items.name: Cubes Masters Zhytomyr 2021
items.information: Новини стосовно швидкубінгу в Україні публікуються на нашій сторінці в [Телеграм](https://t.me/cubing_info). Обговорення змагань буде відбуватись в [Телеграмі](https://t.me/joinchat/D2eJoyBNuE-qxPgJ). На змаганнях буде проведена неофіційна дисципліна — розв’язання кубика 3х3х3 для дітей до 12 років. Записатись на цю дисципліну можна буде на змаганнях, але дуже бажаний попередній запис за телефоном +380 63 324 7832. Вартість участі в неофіційній дисципліні — 30 грн. Будь ласка, ознайомтесь з інформацією на вкладці COVID-19 для підвищення безпеки на змаганнях. *** News regarding Ukrainian Speedcubing are published on our page in [Telegram](https://t.me/cubing_info). Discussion of the competition will be held in [Telegram](https://t.me/joinchat/D2eJoyBNuE-qxPgJ). At the competition an unofficial event will be held — solving of 3x3x3 Cube for kids under 12 years. Signing up for this event will be possible at competition, but it is highly recommended to sign up in advance by phone +380 63 324 7832. Participation fee in unofficial event — 30 UAH (~$1). Please review the COVID-19 tab for information regarding steps taken to increase the competitor safety at this competition.

items.name: Pikes Peak Summer A 2021

venue.name: Discovery Canyon Campus
venue.address: 1810 North Gate Blvd, Colorado Springs, CO 80921, USA
venue.details: Cafeteria. Enter through K-5 entrance, follow signs to right.

items.information: # The competition has been cancelled due to many COVID cases in the USA. # Registration is now closed and the waitlist is full. ### **THIS IS A TWIN COMPETITION. YOU MAY ONLY SIGN UP FOR *ONE* (EITHER A OR B) OF THE COMPETITIONS.** This competition will take place on Saturday. There will be an identical competition also occuring on Sunday, which you can find [here.](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PikesPeakSummerB2021) This competition will be following unique precautions to protect competitors and spectators against COVID-19. We kindly ask you to read the *Competitor Responsibilities and COVID-19 Safety tab* before registering. Due to indoor event guidance in Colorado, the competitor limit for this competition is 50 competitors. Competitors are being asked to bring only one spectator maximum to the competition, and if possible, to attend alone.
